verdict.rationale: Fenwick & West is a law firm, a professional-services provider rather than a software or API product, so a downloadable OpenAPI spec is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence mentions client extranets and 'web services' built by Fenwick Labs but shows no public API or spec, and probes of the standard OpenAPI paths all returned 404, so the exception for a shipped capability does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
